ORDINANCE VI OF 1991
ORDINANCE VI OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (PAYMENT OF DEARNESS ALLOWANCE TO CERTAIN
EMPLOYEES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1991
An Ordinance to amend the
North-West Frontier (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain Employees)
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 25th May, 1991]
No. Legis./1(2)/90, dated
25-5-1991.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the North-West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain
Employees) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 1st day of December,
1990.
